topic: The Jobcenter needs documents for your application to continue benefits (Weiterbewilligungsantrag).
summary: You applied for your Bürgergeld to continue. The Jobcenter can only process the application once you send three documents. The deadline is 05.12.2026. If the documents are missing, the Jobcenter may stop the payment fully or partly. This is a routine letter and no reason to panic, but you should act quickly.

deadlines.what: Send bank statements, payslip and service-charge statement to the Jobcenter.

what_they_want: Statements for all bank accounts for the last three months
The current service-charge statement for your flat (Nebenkostenabrechnung)
if_you_do_nothing: The Jobcenter may refuse Bürgergeld fully or partly for lack of cooperation (§ 66 SGB I). You might then get no money or less money from December.
what_to_do: Copy the documents and keep the originals.
Send them with the reply letter below or upload them at jobcenter.digital.
If you can't get something by 05.12: ask in writing for more time before the deadline.
Keep the receipt or take a photo when you post the letter.

key_terms.explanation: Application for Bürgergeld to continue after the approval period ends.
Your duty to give the office the documents it needs to decide.
The office does not pay because documents are missing. Once you send them, payment can resume.

where_to_get_help: Migration advice for adults (MBE), free of charge
Social advice at Caritas, Diakonie or AWO
